boeing_baseline_text: 1.1 (a) Definitions: "Buyer" means Cymbal Aerospace Corporation or its wholly-owned aerospace subsidiary identified on the face of the Master Purchase Agreement (`BA-2026-AV-8921`). "Seller" means Apex AeroSystems Inc. or the legal entity furnishing Goods and flight-critical software hereunder. "Goods" means the Triple-Redundant Fly-By-Wire Flight Control Computers (`FCC-900`), Line Replaceable Units (`LRUs`), embedded DAL-A flight control firmware, and associated technical deliverables specified in Statement of Work (`SOW-AV-8921`) Schedule A. (b) Order of Precedence: In the event of any ambiguity or inconsistency among Contract documents, Special Provisions (`SP3` International & Tariff Provisions and `SP5` Cybersecurity & Defense Provisions) shall take precedence over these General Provisions (`GP1`), expressly excluding the Firm-Fixed-Price (`FFP`) unit price locks and $45,000,000 aggregate ceiling set forth in GP1 §3.1 and SOW Schedule A, which shall govern over any conflicting Special Provision unless modified by a formal bilateral Change Order.

(b) Invoicing & Payment Integrity: Seller shall submit itemized electronic invoices upon DDP acceptance of each production lot at Buyer's Everett or Renton final assembly line, payable Net Sixty (60) days. Any unilateral invoice surcharge not authorized by an executed GP1 §3.1 Change Order shall be automatically rejected.

boeing_baseline_text: 5.2 (a) Flight-Critical Avionics Preservation: Seller shall clean, preserve, pack, mark, and ship all `FCC-900` Flight Control Computer LRUs in strict accordance with Cymbal Aerospace Supplier Packaging Specification `D6-81628` and Air Transport Association (`ATA`) Spec 300 Category I reusable container and MIL-STD-1686 Class 1 electro-static discharge (`ESD`) protection standards. (b) Traceability & Barcoding: Each individual LRU chassis and exterior shipping container shall bear permanent UID/GS1-128 serialized barcoding, shock-watch and tilt-indicator telemetry seals, desiccant humidity indicators, and an enclosed FAA Form 8130-3 Authorized Release Certificate. Any shipment arriving with tripped shock indicators or breached ESD shielding shall be rejected at Seller's sole expense.

boeing_baseline_text: 15.1 (a) Unilateral Right to Terminate: Buyer may terminate all or any severable portion of this Contract for convenience at any time by written notice of termination to Seller. Upon receipt of such notice, Seller shall immediately stop all terminated work, place no further sub-tier purchase orders for raw materials or semiconductors, and protect all property in which Buyer has or may acquire an interest. (b) Termination Settlement & Cap: Seller's sole recovery upon termination for convenience, aligned with `FAR 52.249-2` principles, shall be limited to documented actual costs incurred for work-in-process prior to termination notice plus a reasonable profit on completed work, never to exceed the terminated portion of the GP1 §3.1 Firm-Fixed-Price Contract value, with zero recovery for anticipatory or consequential profits.
